svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Screen map (Bin Wall)
svg.desc: Thumbnails of the other key screens in the Bin Wall concept.
svg.text: Screen map: the other key screens, in flow order
Plans are saved automatically and shared by all users.
New Plan, with an import error
is not a valid date. Fix the row and upload the file again.
Or reuse the import of a saved plan
Settings: period 12 months · limits 24 / 6 / 1 · pick group 5 shared jobs
0 picks · dead stock · in a best location
Locations (list view; wall view per aisle)
Row action: Manual move… (any location in the Locations file)
214 pick groups · 5 or more shared jobs
Brake pads + disc, front - VW Golf
Best locations: marking on the wall
Hover a level rail: “Mark level 1 in aisle A”. The tool never guesses best.
Marks change the plan only; the import stays as uploaded.
Rows expand to the parts that move in and out. Updates after every move.
Move list: print view (black and white)
Round 1 · one walk · from-location before to-location
Lines follow Walk Path; an emptied location
always comes before a move into it.
